processing.description: Mexican entities selected; outer rings generalized for a 480x320 weather overlay. A cartographic reference, not legal boundary data.
processing.method: Douglas-Peucker on outer rings; longitude scaled by cos(23 degrees); endpoints and ring closure retained
processing.city_selection: Mexican places with source pop_max >= 150000 or administrative-capital status, plus GeoNames Xalapa
processing.population_usage: Source snapshot used only to rank labels; not a current census count
processing.city_priority: Lower values are selected first; Xalapa is highlighted. Apply min_zoom, visible viewport and label collision checks.
